newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies nine muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies nine muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Corp said Wednesday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Miami County Public Building Authority, Kan., $4.77 million bonds.
--Genesee County, Miss., $17.445 million sewer district bonds.
--Albany County, N.Y., $28.7 million public improvement bonds.
--Babylon Union Free School District, N.Y., $6.34 million school bonds.
--University of South Carolina, $25 million revenue bonds.
--Dallas, Texas, $62 million water and sewer bonds.
